searchText: Question regarding the rollup centric roadmap. Wasn't the number of shards reduced to 64 to make cross-shard transactions easier? Would a rollup centric roadmap imply that we could bump this up for even more scalability gain? This view might help with debugging: https://beaconcha.in/validator/33710/stats just added 🙂 <@!97774605351010304> in those stats there is a bug for validators with an index over the minimum-genesis-validator-count, but still part of genesis (within time for freeze). It looks like those lost 32 ETH on the first day. yep, saw it, should be fixed by tmrw 😄 fixed
